title: Turkish-Style German Bean Pide
description: A hearty German-inspired pide filled with flavorful Turkish-style beans. Perfect for a satisfying and comforting meal.

ingredients.name: quirky beans
ingredients.notes: such as cannellini or Great Northern beans

ingredients.name: turkish spices
ingredients.notes: such as sumac, paprika, and cumin

instructions: Roll out the pide dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6mm).
Spread the dense tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Top the sauce with the quirky beans, followed by the turkish spices.
Place the baked mozzarella on top of the beans.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Place the pide on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
